from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, identifying itself and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this document explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate data from all provided papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
